title: Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management
exclusions: Covers the detection logic documented for 'Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management' only. Does not supplant cross-domain SIEM playbooks for unrelated domains or regulatory attestation. Entities listed in `linux_capacity_exceptions.csv` during approved tests are excluded.
evidence: Saved search `linux_pre_launch_and_lingering_session_management` (UC-2.6.35), SOC dashboard panel "Linux — Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management", and weekly export to `index=audit_evidence` sourcetype=csv:linux_controls.

controlTest.positiveScenario: UC-2.6.35 positive (Pre, Launch, and, Lingering, Session): ingest synthetic events into `index=xd` sourcetype='citrix:broker:events' where `users` grouped by `_time`, `session_type`, `delivery_group`, `published_app` satisfies detection threshold for 'Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management'.  Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row.
controlTest.negativeScenario: UC-2.6.35 negative (Session Management): ingest benign `xd` / `citrix:broker:events` events where `_time`, `session_type`, `delivery_group`, `published_app` stays below detection threshold, or exclude the test entity via `linux_capacity_exceptions.csv`. Variant 4 confirms zero alert rows for 'Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management'.

dataSources: `index=xd` `sourcetype="citrix:broker:events"` (session, idle, prelaunch, `SessionState`), `sourcetype="citrix:vda:events"` (disconnect, idle timer), `index=uberagent` `sourcetype="uberAgent:Session:SessionInfo"` or `sourcetype="uberAgent:Process:ProcessStartup"` for per-session process counts
app: uberAgent UXM (Splunkbase 1448), Template for Citrix XenDesktop 7 (TA-XD7-Broker)
spl:
index=xd sourcetype="citrix:broker:events" (match(_raw, "(?i)pre[\s-]*launch|lingering|ghost|idle|disc") OR event_type IN ("SessionDisconnect", "SessionInfo") OR match(event_type, "(?i)SessionPreLaunch"))
| eval session_type=if(match(_raw, "(?i)pre[\s-]*launch|prelaunch"), "prelaunch", if(match(_raw, "(?i)linger|disconnected|idle"), "idle_linger", "other"))
| where session_type!="other"
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count, dc(user) as users, values(session_id) as sample_sessions by _time, session_type, delivery_group, published_app
| table _time, session_type, delivery_group, published_app, count, users, sample_sessions
description: Identifies risk tied to Pre, Launch, and, Lingering, Session through UC-2.6.35 on `index=xd` sourcetype `citrix:broker:events`. Summarises `users` grouped by `_time`, `session_type`, `delivery_group`, `published_app` across `1h` before applying configured threshold. Operators tune 'Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management' using UC-2.6.35 runbook steps.
value: Tracking `users` via UC-2.6.35 on `citrix:broker:events` feeds improves response to 'Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management' and reduces capacity incidents, patch regressions, and service outages.
implementation: Map published app and user fields. For ghost capacity, also pull uberAgent session or host CPU to correlate pre-launch with sustained resource use. Compare counts against GPO- or policy-driven idle and disconnect timers. Alert when pre-launch or linger counts exceed rolling baselines, or when idle sessions outnumber active sessions in a business hour window.
visualization: Area chart (prelaunch vs idle_linger by group), Table (top published apps with linger), Donut (session type mix).
knownFalsePositives:
1. **Patch Tuesday on `xd`** — Package managers spike `_time` metrics for 'Pre-Launch and Lingering Session Management'. Correlate with apt/yum logs in the same `citrix:broker:events` window.

2. **Nightly backup I/O on `_time`** — Predictable `dc` burst on fixed cron; compare `_time` minute before paging.

3. **Synthetic probe on `citrix:broker:events`** — Nagios/Zabbix polls `_time` and mimics sustained load without crossing capacity threshold.

4. **New host onboarding** — `_time` baseline unstable first 48h after UF deploy.

**Suppression mechanism:** `linux_capacity_exceptions.csv` keyed on `_time`, `valid_until`.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Install and configure the required add-on or app: uberAgent UXM (Splunkbase 1448), Template for Citrix XenDesktop 7 (TA-XD7-Broker).
• Ensure the following data sources are available: `sourcetype="citrix:broker:events"`, `sourcetype="citrix:vda:events"`, `index=uberagent` optional.
• For app installation, inputs.conf, and Splunk directory layout, see the Implementation guide: docs/implementation-guide.md

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Ensure session-related broker events are indexed with consistent `event_type` and user fields. If event names differ by version, centralize a macro with OR clauses. Ingest VDA `CtxSession` or equivalent event ids as needed for idle/linger details.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
Run the following SPL in Search (then save as report or alert; extend `event_type` list to your build):

```spl
index=xd sourcetype="citrix:broker:events" (match(_raw, "(?i)pre[\s-]*launch|lingering|ghost|idle|disc") OR event_type IN ("SessionDisconnect", "SessionInfo") OR match(event_type, "(?i)SessionPreLaunch"))
| eval session_type=if(match(_raw, "(?i)pre[\s-]*launch|prelaunch"), "prelaunch", if(match(_raw, "(?i)linger|disconnected|idle"), "idle_linger", "other"))
| where session_type!="other"
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count, dc(user) as users, values(session_id) as sample_sessions by _time, session_type, delivery_group, published_app
| table _time, session_type, delivery_group, published_app, count, users, sample_sessions
```

Step 3 — Validate
For a published app with known pre-launch, compare hourly counts. Spot-check a linger-heavy user against the Citrix session list.

Step 4 — Operationalize
Pair with the desktop policy team. Track improvements after GPO and Citrix policy changes.
grandmaExplanation: We see when apps are left running in the background to start faster, and when people walk away and leave those sessions open — so you catch wasted space and slow computers before they hurt real work.
